result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there is one clear visual defect: in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery-time text and the '€0 delivery' label overlap each other below the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, producing garbled, unreadable text. Other elements (carousel clipping, bottom card cut-off) are expected behaviors and not reported.

issues.description: Below the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the metadata line shows overlapping text: the delivery-time range (e.g. '25–35 min') and the '€0 delivery' label are rendered on top of each other, producing an unreadable jumble ('25–3€0 delivery').
issues.suggestion: Ensure the delivery-time and delivery-fee labels are laid out in a proper horizontal row with adequate spacing (e.g. flex row with gap) instead of being absolutely positioned or stacked in the same space, so each string is fully legible.
